Listening Mission

Talking About Family

Listen to the introduction before we start.

Today you will listen for family members, names, ages, how many children, and school information.

Listen for the person

Listen. Which person is it?

Listen for the name

Listen. What is his name?

Listen for the number

Listen. How many children does she have?

Listen for age

Listen. How old is her son?

Listen for school

Listen to both sentences. Which child goes to school?

Review your answers

Here are your five answers. Listen again any time. If one is not correct, you can fix it.
